claims.head: The Canucks will send Hronek and Pettersson (#25) at Raymond
claims.call: The Canucks’ P1 (Hronek and Pettersson (#25)) spends at least 47% of its 5-on-5 time against the Red Wings’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Canucks keep sending Hronek and Pettersson (#25) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Manny Malhotra has been picking a defense pair for the other team’s top line. Tonight the Red Wings’ first line is Larkin, Arvidsson and Raymond.

notes.text: They dressed 11 forwards and 7 defensemen in 5 of their last 7 games, including the last one. Keegan Kolesar takes shifts on two lines, L3 and L4. Axel Sandin-Pellikka is the seventh defenseman, rotating in mostly beside Johansson and Chiarot.
J.T. Compher is on injured reserve and has missed the last 5 games.
Simon Edvinsson has not played this season. He is a top-pair defenseman. Albert Johansson has taken his spot beside Moritz Seider.

The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 9 games cover only 30% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the fifth-lowest in the league (a typical team: 45%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Marco Rossi is out (illness) and missed their last game. He is a top-six forward.
Max Sasson has started killing penalties: on the ice for 32% of the team’s shorthanded time in 9 games, up from 4% last season.

VAN.head: The Canucks face a real test
VAN.body: Even though Vancouver has home-ice advantage, Detroit has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Canucks’ best way through is getting good looks.

DET.body: Even though Vancouver has home-ice advantage, Detroit has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Canucks’ way back in is getting good looks.

story.head: The Canucks need a win
paras: The Canucks are winless in six (0-5-1). The Red Wings are 2-3-2.

items.text: The Red Wings have been without J.T. Compher since Oct 4, and have had to make do without Simon Edvinsson all season.
The Canucks are newly without Marco Rossi, and have had to make do without Thatcher Demko all season.
Jake DeBrusk has six goals in eight games against Detroit since 2023-24.
